preconditions: dword_7C56A4 must hold the current session type; the value 7 selects the payload-copy branch, any other value selects the minimal-payload branch.

When a2 != -1, the created object's vtable method at offset +12 is invoked with a2.
A progress-bar/session event is encoded through ProgressBarEventEncode (0x004B33B0) using the current session time (dbl_8AFEA0).
The encoded element is dispatched over the network via NetworkSendDispatch (0x0057A6A0).
The function returns the result of VirtualMethodDispatch (0x0057A690) on this+0x3FB8 and the created object.

Reads global dbl_8AFEA0 and passes its low dword to ProgressBarEventEncode.
Creates a COM/UI element object via COMVTableCallVia0x60 (0x0057A680).
Modifies the created object: byte obj[4] = 1 when a2 == -1, or invokes its vtable slot +12 with a2 otherwise.
Dispatches the encoded element via NetworkSendDispatch (0x0057A6A0).
unresolved: External cut callees are out of this packet and must be reconciled before closure: 0x004B33B0 (ProgressBarEventEncode), 0x0057A680 (COMVTableCallVia0x60), 0x0057A690 (VirtualMethodDispatch).
Local v7 is passed by address to NetworkSendDispatch before any write in the raw source; the message id ((v7 >> 8) & 0x3FF) + 8 is derived from an unresolved value.
Ownership and lifetime of the COM object created by COMVTableCallVia0x60 are not evidenced within this function; the object may be COM-refcounted.
The caller 0x00462848 (graph_context) is outside the packet; the owner object supplying 'this' and the element's lifecycle across calls are not established.
dbl_8AFEA0 is read as a double but only its low dword is consumed by ProgressBarEventEncode; the exact semantic of that time value is inferred, not proven.
The byte at this+0x3FD9 counts payload dwords (payload length 4*v9) and the payload starts at this+0x3FDA, but the object type holding this+0x3FB8 and these offsets is unknown.
tests_required: dword_7C56A4 == 7: verify payload copy length is 4*v9 bytes and ProgressBarEventEncode receives v3 = 4*v9 + 2.
dword_7C56A4 != 7: verify v3 == 1 and no payload copy occurs.
a2 == -1: verify obj[4] is set to 1 and the vtable slot +12 method is NOT invoked.
a2 != -1: verify the vtable slot +12 method is invoked with a2.
